title: Scheduled restart
description: Restart the app on a schedule to cap slow memory leaks. It uses the normal restart, so rollout and disruption rules apply. Restarts are at least {{min}} apart.

last.failed: Last run {{at}}: failed, retried after a backoff.

hint: For example 0 3 * * * or @every 24h. Stopped apps, protected environments, freezes and running deploys are skipped, never forced.
